 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 13, 2026, 02:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Work discussions go better than expected for Cancer around midday this Friday. The Moon, your ruling planet, travels through Sagittarius, your sixth house of daily work and office relations, and forms a sextile with Mercury in Libra, your fourth. Mercury is standing still today before it turns direct tonight, which makes its influence unusually strong. Conversations with a manager, client or colleague flow more smoothly in this window. But Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your ninth house of principles, casts its tenth aspect straight onto the Moon. It wants every claim you make backed by solid evidence. A Clear Window Around Noon 
 Mercury rules your third house of communication. Its friendly link with the Moon in your work house sharpens explanations and makes responses more cooperative. If you need to discuss a project update, a schedule change or a workload issue, aim for late morning to early afternoon. Prepare a summary before the meeting. Clarity wins today. Shani Asks for Proof 
 Shani in your ninth house values truth and fairness. Its aspect on the Moon in your sixth means vague answers will not satisfy anyone. Bring numbers, emails, reports or samples to support your points. If you are asking for something, such as more time or resources, show exactly why it is needed. A well-documented case today earns lasting respect. Mercury Turns Direct Tonight 
 After three weeks of mixed signals, Mercury ends its retrograde in your fourth house tonight. Confusion around home-based work, documents or family plans begins to clear. Agreements reached at midday can be written up and confirmed over the weekend with less chance of error. Venus, lord of your eleventh house of gains, turns direct tomorrow, helping work talks convert into tangible benefits. Join conversation

 Ganesha’s Day and Your Yogakaraka 
 Today is Vinayaka Chaturthi, a fitting day to pray before any important meeting. Mars, your yogakaraka, now strong in Leo, your second house, sits with Jupiter, lord of your ninth. Successful talks today could link directly to income in the weeks ahead. What to Do Today 
 Schedule important work conversations between late morning and early afternoon. Carry facts, figures and documents to support every point you raise. Keep explanations short and clear. Avoid making promises you cannot prove you can keep. Write up any agreement reached and confirm it by email over the weekend, after Mercury turns direct. Shani Remedy for Today 
 Offer a bowl of jaggery and grated coconut to Lord Ganesha at noon before your important meeting. Help a job seeker improve their résumé or practise for an interview.
